scope: Proposition 2.6 of the manuscript “Simple F∞ overgroups of groups with decidable word problem” (preprints/Simple-F-infinity-overgroups-of-groups-with-decidable-word-problem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 250 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2e99bf33c152d2e2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Under the assumptions of Theorem 2.2, for every finite bound A and every n ≥ 0 there are an integer k ≥ 0 and a finite bound B such that fk sends every reduced integral n-cycle of CA ∗ (U) to a boundary in CB ∗ (U).
